fields.v: (1) Claude via a CLI coding tool (version and model not stated) + pre-existing specification: no success criterion stated by the authors; five defects introduced and fixed in one session (two diagnosed from a single symptom with a structural fix; one consistency defect reintroduced at a second call site; one performance fix claimed without re-measuring). Quality verdict: no criterion stated by the authors. Cost verdict: no criterion stated by the authors (no cost measured). Retrieval ablation (not an agent configuration): filtered vs unfiltered retrieval, recall@1 0.500 vs 0.420; recall@10 1.000 vs 0.845; exact match at k = 10 1.000 vs 0.690; sign test p < 10^-4 at every k

fields.v: Single-session, single-agent case study; defect frequencies not claimed to generalise (including to smaller models); retrieval ablation substitutes gold entity labels and uses recall rather than HotpotQA's own metrics. Several defects had no static or type-level signature, arguing for execution-based evaluation of agentic systems work; the development loop had no mechanism forcing re-measurement against the regression a fix targeted or an external benchmark
